t: The novel draws mainly on Chen Shou's Records of the Three Kingdoms, but adds fictional scenes, speeches and supernatural episodes, and gives its moral weight to Liu Bei and Shu Han.
Its best-known opening line, on the empire long divided and long united, was added by Mao Lun and Mao Zonggang in their recension, and none of the earlier editions contained it.
Translated first into Manchu in 1650 and later into many languages, it is regarded in Korea, Japan and Vietnam as a canonical work and has been called the national novel of Korea.
dyk: Zhuge Liang's southern campaign, which Chen Shou described in a few sentences as a single action, became seven battles in the Mao edition, in which the rebel leader Meng Huo is captured and released seven times.
ev: The Sanguozhi Pinghua, the earliest written work to combine the Three Kingdoms stories, is published sometime between 1321 and 1323
The novel is first printed as Sanguozhi Tongsu Yanyi, in an edition bearing a preface dated 1494
Zhou Yue publishes an illustrated edition in 12 volumes, with 240 two-page illustrations
A Manchu translation based on the 1522 edition, completed in 1647, is published
Mao Lun and Mao Zonggang edit the text into 120 chapters during the reign of the Kangxi Emperor
Théodore Pavie begins publishing a French translation, the first into a European language
Charles Henry Brewitt-Taylor publishes a complete English translation in two volumes
Moss Roberts publishes a full English translation with maps, a list of characters and notes

f.made: Attributed to Luo Guanzhong, a playwright who lived sometime between 1315 and 1400; the standard text is a recension of the 1660s by Mao Lun and his son Mao Zonggang
f.form: A Chinese historical novel of 120 chapters, about 800,000 words, with nearly a thousand characters, mostly historical, mixing history, fiction and supernatural episodes
f.where: Luo's 24-volume Sanguozhi Tongsu Yanyi is held in the Shanghai Library and the Tenri Central Library in Japan, among other libraries; the Mao text is the one general readers use
f.known: The Oath of the Peach Garden; Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei; Zhuge Liang; the Battle of Red Cliffs; Cao Cao; the opening line on division and union; one of the Four Great Classic Novels
